intro: bb drives the Bashboard pane it runs in.

commands.name: open
commands.summary: Show a folder in the Files pane, or a file's folder with it selected
commands.details: The path must exist. Relative paths resolve against the folder bb runs in.

commands.name: edit
commands.summary: Open the file in the preferred editor
commands.details: A trailing :<digits> is the line to open at, 1 or more. Folders open too.

commands.name: git
commands.summary: Open the Git pane for this folder's repo
commands.details: Outside a repo it reports "not a git repository".

commands.name: search
commands.summary: Open a Search pane for this folder's repo
commands.details: The query is filled in when given. Outside a repo it searches the current folder.

commands.name: scratch
commands.summary: Open a scratch pad holding the text, or piped standard input
commands.details: Without arguments it reads standard input, up to 1 MiB.

commands.name: auth
commands.summary: Store a Bitbucket API token for the Ship pane
commands.details: Prompts for the token with echo off, or reads it from standard input, and saves it in Windows Credential Manager. --clear removes it. Works outside Bashboard too.

commands.name: help
commands.details: bb, bb -h, and bb --help do the same, and work outside Bashboard too.
